calibration._note: Hawaii's reefs sit right off deep water, so far less energy is lost on the way in than in Florida (shelf 0.9 vs 0.6), and there's little refraction to bend swell around the island (sharper exposure falloff). Heights are wave faces, not the Hawaiian scale (about half). Starting guesses.
